about.about: Computer engineer with a solid foundation in software development, clean architecture, and automation, currently focused on artificial intelligence and machine learning. I have applied prompt engineering techniques and LLMs to optimize documentation tasks and component generation in Android, exploring AI's potential in production environments. Focused on strengthening my knowledge in machine learning and scalable AI system design, combining engineering, data, and creativity to build intelligent and sustainable solutions.

projects.name: Portfolio Angular Template
projects.description: Professional portfolio template developed with Angular and TypeScript. Designed with clean architecture, CI/CD integration via GitHub Actions, and automatic deployment on GitHub Pages. Its modular and reusable structure allows easy adaptation for other developers or personal projects.

projects.name: AI-Powered Flutter Test Generator (Thesis Project)
projects.description: Mobile app that generates multiple-choice exams from a syllabus PDF. Follows Clean Architecture with data/domain/presentation layers and BLoC for state management. Integrates Firebase with Gemini LLM for question generation and auto-grading, and stores results (score, correct/incorrect answers) allowing review and resuming of exams. UI built with Material Design 3, accessible, with native theme support synchronized with the system.

projects.name: Fine-Tuning Stable Diffusion 1.5 with Textual Inversion and LoRA
projects.description: Project focused on customizing image generation models using fine-tuning techniques on Stable Diffusion 1.5. Textual Inversion and LoRA methods were used to obtain visually consistent characters from small datasets, optimizing the balance between visual fidelity and the model's generalization capability.

achievements: Participated in the design and development of a reusable component library in Jetpack Compose, improving visual consistency and scalability across multiple Android projects.
Implemented internal tools based on OpenAI and Gemini to automate documentation and workflows, helping to optimize team productivity.
Collaborated in creating unit and UI tests with Jetpack Compose Testing, integrating them into the development cycle to ensure product stability and quality.
Applied SOLID principles and Clean Architecture to promote modular, maintainable, and easily testable code.
Final Project Grade: 10/10 — 'Implementation of a Flutter interface for tests generated from a PDF topic'.
